items.title: 52986_Lawrence Brown oral history interview
items.q: Taylor was his name. And so I took his place.

ctx.x: It was a band that at that time was working out of the Cotton Club which was the biggest night club in the West. And oneof their members was sick and he had to move back to Chicago. And he happened to be a trombone player.
Taylor was his name. And so I took his place. And that was the beginning of the big time cabaret sessions.
And they had where -- a steady house band there.
